description: This script generates code for Lazy Tensor backend in PyTorch, including IR classes, native function declarations, and registration code, based on YAML definitions and templates.

classes.name: ParsedExternalYaml
classes.description: Named tuple holding parsed external YAML data: backend key, autograd key, namespace, backend indices, and full_codegen list.

classes.name: default_args
classes.description: Configuration class with default argument values for code generation.

methods.name: parse_native_functions_keys
methods.description: Parses YAML file to extract full_codegen, non_native, and ir_gen operator lists.

methods.name: validate_shape_inference_header
methods.description: Checks that the shape inference header file contains all expected declarations.

methods.name: get_ltc_helper_fns
methods.description: Returns helper functions for converting tensors to meta tensors.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the script, parses arguments and initiates code generation.

methods.name: run_gen_lazy_tensor
methods.description: Performs the code generation process for Lazy Tensor backend, including IR classes, native functions, and registration code.
